items.title: 68190_Samuel
items.q: Ben came off the band stand and he shook my hand and said, 'Well Lovett, I'm sure glad to see you man, but I'm going to tell you one thing.

ctx.x: I walked in there man and Ben -- it was intermission when I walked in, see. Ben came off the band stand and he shook my hand and said, 'Well Lovett, I'm sure glad to see you man, but I'm going to tell you one thing. Please don't go up there and show me up, man.' I said, 'Man, I didn't come here for nothing like that'. I said, 'I don't want to play anyway, you understand what I mean'.
So I went up there and played man and people started throwing hats up and everything and all that stuff and he came back down and said, 'Didn't I tell you not to do that'.
